G3100.def:
μαθητεύω
(μαθητής),
__1. intrans. (as prop. vb. in -εύω, and so Plut., mor. 837 with and elsew.), to be a disciple: with dative, Mt 27:57 (Rec., WH, mg.).
__2. Trans., to make a disciple: with accusative, Mt 28:19, At 14:21; pass., before dative, τ. Ἰησοῦ, Mt 27:57 (WH, R); τ. βασιλείᾳ, Mt 13:52.†
(AS)

G3101.def:
μαθητής, -οῦ, ὁ (μανθάνω),
[in LXX only as seel. (A) in Jr 13:21 20:11 26(46):9 * ;]
a disciple: opposite to διδάσκαλος, Mt 10:24, Lc 6:40; Ἰωάννου, Mt 9:14, Lc 7:18, Jo 3:25; τ. Φαρισσίων, Mt 22:16, Mc 2:18, Lc 5:33; Μωυσέως, Jo 9:28; Ἰησοῦ, Lc 6:17 7:11 19:37, Jo 6:66 7:3 19:38; esp. the twelve, Mt 10:1 11:1, Mc 7:17, Lc 8:9, Jo 2:2, al.; later, of Christians generally, At 6:1, 2 7 9:19, al.; τ. κυρίου, At 9:1.
(AS)

G3102.def:
μαθήτρια, -ας, ἡ
(= μαθητρίς, fem, of μαθητής, which see)
a female disciple: At 9:36.†
(AS)

G3105.def:
μαίνομαι
[in LXX: Jr 25:16 (הָלַל hith.) Jr 29:26 (שָׁגַע pu.), Wis.14:28, a). ;]
__1. to rage, be furious.
__2. to rave, be mad: Jo 10:29, At 12:15 26:24-25, 1Co 14:23 (cf. ἐμ-μαίνομαι).†
(AS)

G3106.def:
μακαρζω
(μακάριος), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pi., pu. ;]
to bless, pronounce blessed or happy: with accusative of person(s), Lc 1:48, Tg 5:11.†
(AS)

G3107.def:
μακάριος, -α, -ον
(collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), [in LXX for אֹשֶׁר ;]
blessed, happy (DCG, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), 1Tm 1:11 6:15; ἐλπίς, Tt 2:13; esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, Pr., 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, Mt 5:3 ff., Lc 6:20 ff. Jo 20:29, Ap 1:3, al.; before ptcp., Lc 1:45, al.; ὅς, Mt 11:6, Lc 7:23, Rm 4:7-8; ὅτι, Mt 13:16, al.; ἐάν, Jo 13:17, 1Co 7:40; compar., μ. . . . μᾶλλον, At 20:35; -ώτερος, 1Co 7:40
SYN.: εὐλογητός, q.v (AS)

G3108.def:
μακαρισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μακαρίζω)
a declaration of blessedness, felicitation: Rm 4:6, 9, Gl 4:15 (Plat., Arist.).†
(AS)

G3109.def:
Μακεδονία, -ας, ἡ
Macedonia: At 16:9-10, 1Co 16:5, 2Co 1:16, Fp 4:15, al.; M. καὶ Ἀχαία, At 19:21, Rm 15:26, 1Ts 1:7-8
(AS)

G3111.def:
μάκελλον, -ου, τό (Lat. macellum),
a meat-market: 1Co 10:25 (see Deiss., LAE, 274; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3112.def:
μακράν (prop. fem. accusative of μακρός, Sc. ὁδόν), adv. ,
[in LXX for רָחוֹק hi., רָחַק, etc. ;]
a long way, far: Lc 15:20, At 22:21; before ἀπό, Mt 8:30, Lc 7:6, Jo 21:8, At 17:27; id. metaphorically, Mc 12:34; οἱ εἰς μ., At 2:39 (cf. Is 2:2); metaphorically, οἱ ποτὲ ὄντες μ. (opposite to ἐγγύς), Ef 2:13; οἱ μ., Ef 2:17.†
(AS)

G3113.def:
μακρόθεν
(μακρός),
adv. (chiefly late),
[in LXX for רָחוֹק, רָחַק, etc. ;]
from afar, afar: Lc 18:13 22:54; ἀπὸ μ. (Sl 138:6, Et 3:13, al.), Mt 26:58 27:55, Mc 5:6 8:3 11:13 14:54 15:40, Lc 16:23 23:49, Ap 18:10, 15 18:17.†
(AS)

G3114.def:
μακροθυμέω, -ῶ
(μακρό-θυμος, long-tempered; see: -ία), [in LXX: Ec 8:12 א2, Pv 19:11 (אָרַךְ, אַף אָרַךְ), Jó 7:16, Sir.2:4, al. ;]
__1. actively = καρτερέω, to persevere (Plut., 2, 593 F).
__2. Passively, to be patient, long-suffering: absol., 1Co 13:4, Hb 6:15, Tg 5:8; before ἕως, with genitive, Tg 5:7; ἐπί, with dative, ib. (Sir.2:4); πρός, with accusative, 1Ts 5:14; ἐπί, with dative, Mt 18:26, 29, Lc 18:7; εἰς, 2Pe 3:9.†
SYN.: ὑπομένω, q.v (AS)

G3115.def:
μακροθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(μακρό-θυμος), [in LXX: Pv 25:15 (אַף אֹרֶךְ), Jr 15:15 (אַף אָרֵךְ) Is 57:15, Sir.5:11, 1Ma.8:4 * ;],
patience, longsuffering: of men, esp. in experiencing troubles and difficulties, Cl 1:11, 2Tm 3:10, Hb 6:12, Tg 5:10; of God's forbearance, Rm 2:4 9:22, 2Co 6:6, Gl 5:22, Ef 4:2, Cl 3:12, 1Tm 1:16, 2Tm 4:2, 1Pe 3:20, 2Pe 3:15.†
SYN.: ὑπομονή (cf. Lft., Col., 138; Tr., Syn., liii) (AS)

G3117.def:
μακρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for אָרֹךְ, רָחוֹק and cognate forms, etc. ;]
of space and time, long: μακρὰ προσεύχεσθαι, Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47.
of distance, far, far distant: χώρα, Lc 15:13 19:12.†
(AS)

G3118.def:
μακρο-χρόνιος, -ον
(μακρός, χρόνος), [in LXX. μ. γίγνεσθαι, εἶναι (יוֹם אָרַךְ), Êx 20:12, Dt 4:40 5:16 17:20 * ;]
of long duration, longlived: Ef 6:3 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3119.def:
μαλακία -ας, ἡ
(μαλακός), [in LXX chiefly for חֳלִי Dt 7:15 28:61, Is 38:9 53:3, al. ;]
__1. prop., softness, effeminacy (Hdt., Thuc., al).
__2. In NT, as in LXX, = ἀσθένεια, weakness, sickness: νόσος καὶ μ., Mt 4:23 9:35 10:1.†
SYN.: see: ἀσθένεια (AS)

G3120.def:
μαλακός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Pv 25:15 (רַךְ) Pv 26:22 (לָהַם)* ;]
soft;
__1. prop., to the touch (opposite to σκληρός): of clothing, pl., Mt 11:8, Lc 7:25.
__2. Of persons and their mode of living;
__(a) mild, gentle;
__(b) soft, effeminate: 1Co 6:9 (prob. in obscene sense, cf. Deiss., LAE, 150, 4; MM, xvi; Zorell, see word).†
(AS)

G3122.def:
μάλιστα, see: μάλα.
μάλα
adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nm 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Gn 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;]
__I. Pos., very, very much, exceedingly (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.).
__II. Compar., μᾶλλον.
__1. Of increase, more; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, Mc 10:48, Lc 18:39, Rm 5:15, 17, Fp 2:12, al.; πόσῳ, Lc 12:24, Rm 11:12, al.; τοσούτῳ . . . ὅσῳ, Hb 10:25.
__2. Of comparison, the more: Lc 5:15, Jo 5:18, At 5:14, 1Ts 4:1, 10, 2Pe 1:10; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., Fp 1:9; with compar., Mc 7:36, 2Co 7:13; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, Fp 1:23; μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, Mt 6:26; μ. ἤ, Mt 18:13; with genitive, 1Co 14:18; as periphr. for compar., At 20:35, 1Co 9:15, Gl 4:27; μ. δέ (EV, yea rather), Rm 8:34.
__3. Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, Mt 6:30, al.; πολύ, Hb 12:25; πόσῳ, Mt 7:11, al.; in a question, οὐ μ., 1Co 9:12; after a neg., Mt 10:6, al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., 1Co 14:5, 2Co 5:8; ζηλῶ, 1Co 14:1; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, Jo 3:19; μ. δέ, Gl 4:9.
__III. Superl., μάλιστα
, most, most of all, above all: At 20:38 25:26, Gl 6:10, Fp 4:22, 1Tm 4:10 5:8, 17, 2Tm 4:13, Tt 1:10, Phm 16, 2Pe 2:10; μ. γνώστης, At 26:3
(AS)

μάλα
adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nm 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Gn 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;]

__2. __3. Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, Mt 6:30, al.; πολύ, Hb 12:25; πόσῳ, Mt 7:11, al.; in a question, οὐ μ., 1Co 9:12; after a neg., Mt 10:6, al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., 1Co 14:5, 2Co 5:8; ζηλῶ, 1Co 14:1; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, Jo 3:19; μ. δέ, Gl 4:9.
__III. Superl., μάλιστα
, most, most of all, above all: At 20:38 25:26, Gl 6:10, Fp 4:22, 1Tm 4:10 5:8, 17, 2Tm 4:13, Tt 1:10, Phm 16, 2Pe 2:10; μ. γνώστης, At 26:3
(AS)

adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nm 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Gn 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;]

G3125.def:
μάμμη, -ης, ἡ
(onomatop.), [in LXX: 4Ma.16:9 * ;]
__1. in cl., a child's name for mother.
__2. In late Gk. (= cl., τήθη), a grandmother: (LXX, l.with), 2Tm 1:5.†
(AS)

G3126.def:
μαμωνᾶς (Rec. μαμμ-), -ᾶ (Bl., § 7, 4), ό (Aram. מָמוֺנָא),
mammon, riches: Mt 6:24, Lc 16:9, 11 16:13.†
(AS)

G3128G.def:
Μανασσῆς, -ῆ, ὁ (Heb. מְנַשֶּׁה),
Manasseh;
__1. (a) the first-born son of Joseph;
__(b) the tribe which bore his name: Ap 7:6.
__2. King of Judah: Mt 1:10.†
(AS)

G3128H.def:
Μανασσῆς, -ῆ, ὁ (Heb. מְנַשֶּׁה),
Manasseh;
__1. (a) the first-born son of Joseph;
__(b) the tribe which bore his name: Ap 7:6.
__2. King of Judah: Mt 1:10.†
(AS)

G3129.def:
μανθάνω
[in LXX chiefly for לָמַד ;]
__1. to learn, esp. by inquiry: absol., 1Co 14:31, 1Tm 2:11, 2Tm 3:7; with accusative of thing(s), Jo 7:15 (sc. αὐτά), Rm 16:17, 1Co 14:35, Fp 4:9, 2Tm 3:14, Ap 14:3; before quaes. indir., Mt 9:13; Χριστόν, Ef 4:20 (ICC, in l); before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), Mt 24:32, Mc 13:28; ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Mt 11:29, Cl 1:7; παρά, with genitive of person(s), 2Tm 3:14; ἐν, with dative of person(s), 1Co 4:6; "point" aorist (M, Pr., 117), to ascertain, before ὅτι, At 23:27; with accusative before ἀπό, Gl 3:2.
__2. to learn by use and practice, acquire the habit of, be accustomed to: with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4), 1Tm 5:4, Tt 3:14; id. with nom, in pred. (El., § 72, 1), Fp 4:11; with accusative of thing(s) before ἀπό, Hb 5:8; ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν (EV, they learn to be idle; Bl., § 73, 5; Field, Notes, 210), 1Tm 5:13.†
(AS)

G3130.def:
μανία, -ας, ἡ
(μαίνομαι) [in LXX: Os 9:7-8 מַשְׂטֵמָה), Wis.5:4, al. ;]
frenzy, madness: At 26:24.†
(AS)

G3131.def:
μάννα, τό ,
(in FlJ, also ἡ),
indecl.
[in LXX: τὸ μάν, Êx 16:31 ff., elsewhere τ. μάννα, Nm 11:6 ff., al. (מָן, Aram. מַנָּא) ;]
manna: Jo 6:31, 49, Hb 9:4; symb., Ap 2:17.†
(AS)

G3132.def:
μαντεύομαι
(μαντίς, a seer, diviner), [in LXX for קָסַם, Dt 18:10, al. ;]
to divine, practise divination: At 16:16.†
SYN.: προφητεύω, which see, in distinction from which μ. is used in LXX and NT only of false prophets and those who practise the heathen arts of divination and soothsaying (cf. 1Rs 28:8, and see Tr., Syn., § vi) (AS)

G3133.def:
μαραίνω
[in LXX: Jó 15:30 (יָבֵשׁ pi.), Jó 24:24, Wis.2:8 19:21 * ;]
in cl.,
__1. prop., to quench fire; pass., of fire, to die away, go out.
__2. In various relations, to quench, waste, wear out (cf. Wis.19:21); pass., to waste away; in later writers (Plut., Luc., al.), of the withering of flowers and herbage (act., Jó 15:30; pass., Jó 24:24, Wis.2:8): Tg 1:11 (cf. ἀμάραντον).†
(AS)

G3134.def:
μαρὰν ἀθά (Rec. μαραναθά; Aram.: on the original form see Dalman, Gr., § 41, 1; 74, 3; Words, 328),
Maranatha, i.e. the Lord cometh (but see Dalman, ll. with; Field, Notes, 180; ICC, in l): 1Co 16:22.†
(AS)

G3135.def:
μαργαρίτης, -ου, ὁ
a pearl: Mt 13:45-46, 1Tm 2:9, Ap 17:4 18:12, 16 21:21 (-ῖται, WH); proverbially, Mt 7:6.†
(AS)

G3137G.def:
Μαρία, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; Heb. מִרְיָם)
Mary. In NT;
__1. the mother of Jesus: Mt 1:16 ff. Mt 2:11 13:55, Mc 6:3, Lc 1:27 ff. Lc 2:5, 16 2:19, 34, At 1:14
__2. M. Magdalene (which see).
__3. The wife of Clopas (Jo 19:25) and mother of James the little, and Joses: Mt 27:56, 61 28:1, Mc 15:40, 47 16:1, Lc 24:10.
__4. The sister of Martha and Lazarus: Lc 10:39, 42 Jo 11:1-2, 19 ff. Jo 12:3.
__5. The mother of John Mark: At 12:12.
__6. A Christian greeted by St. Paul: Rm 16:6 (on the signification of the name, see Zorell, see word; on the use of the alternative forms in NT, DB, iii, 278 bn).†
(AS)

G3137I.def:
Μαρία, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; Heb. מִרְיָם)

(AS)

G3138.def:
Μάρκος, -ου, ὁ,
Mark: Mk., title., At 12:12, 25 15:37, 39, Cl 4:10, 2Tm 4:11, Phm 24, 1Pe 5:13 (see Swete, Mk., Intr., xiii ff.; DB, iii, 245 ff).†
(AS)

G3139.def:
μάρμαρος, -ου, ὁ
(μαρμαίρω, to glisten), [in LXX: Ep. Jr 7:2 * ;]
__1. any crystalline stone (Hom., Eur., al.).
__2. In later writers, marble: Ap 18:12.†
(AS)

G3140.def:
μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
(μάρτυς), [in LXX chiefly for עֵד (עֵד (Gn 31:47-48, al.), also for עוּד hi. (Gn 43:3, La 2:13), עָנָה (Nm 35:30) ;]
__(a) prop., to be a witness, bear witness, testify: absol. (find., al.), Jo 15:27, At 26:5; parenthetical (Bl., § 79, 7; MM, xvi), 2Co 8:3; with dative of person(s) (comm. and incomm.; El., § 37, 2), At 22:5, Hb 10:15; id. before ὅτι, Mt 23:31, Rm 10:2, al.; accusative and inf., At 10:43; with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), Jo 3:11, Ap 22:16, 20; with accusative cogn., before περί, Jo 5:32, 1Jo 5:10; with dative of thing(s), Jo 5:33, At 14:3, al.; before περί, with genitive (of person(s) and of thing(s)), Jo 1:7-8, 15 2:25 18:23 21:24, al.; id. before ὅτι, Jo 5:36 7:7; ὅτι, Jo 1:34 4:44 al.; ὅτι recit., Jo 4:39; κατά before ὅτι, 1Co 15:15; pass., Hb 7:8; ptcp., Rm 3:21; impers., Hb 7:17;
__(b) in late Gk., to witness favourably, give a good report, approve (Bl., § 54, 3; MM, xvi; Deiss., BS, 265): with dative of person(s), Lc 4:22; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), Hb 11:4; pass., At 6:3; before ἐν, 1Tm 5:10, Hb 11:2; διά, with genitive of thing(s), Hb 11:39; with genitive of person(s), At 10:22, al.; impers., III Jn 12 (cf. ἐπι, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-μαρτυρέω)
(AS)

G3141.def:
μαρτυρία, -ας, ἡ
(μαρτυρέω), [in LXX: Gn 31:47 R (גַּלְעֵד), Êx 20:16, Dt 5:20 (17), Pv 25:18, Sl 19:7 (עֵד, עֵדוּת), Pv 12:19, Sir.31:23-24, 4Ma.6:32 * ;]
witness, testimony, evidence: Mc 14:56, Lc 22:71, Jo 5:34 19:35 21:24, 1Tm 3:7, Tt 1:13, 3Jn.12, Ap 11:7; with genitive subj., Mc 14:59, Jo 8:17 (LXX aliter), 1Jo 5:9; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Mc 14:55; esp. of witness concerning Christ and divine things, Jo 1:7 3:11, 32-33 5:32, 36 Ap 6:9; with genitive subj., Jo 1:19 5:31 8:13-14, At 22:18, 1Jo 5:9-11, Ap 12:11; with genitive obj., Ap 1:2, 9 12:17 19:10 20:4; μ. ἔχειν, Ap 6:9 12:17 19:10.†
(AS)

G3142.def:
μαρτύριον, -ου, τό
(μάρτυρ) [in LXX chiefly for מוֹעֵד, also for עֵדָה, עֵדוּת and cogn. forms ;]
a testimony, witness, proof (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive subj., 2Co 1:12, 2Ts 1:10; with genitive obj., At 4:33, 1Co 1:6 2:1 (WH, txt., R, txt., μυστήριον; 2Tm 1:8; εἰς μ., Mt 8:4 10:18 Mt 24:14, Mc 1:44 6:11 13:9, Lc 5:14 9:5 21:13, Hb 3:5, Tg 5:3; τὸ μ. καιροῖς ἰδίοις (CGT, in l), 1Tm 2:6; ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μ. (LXX for מוֹעֵד אֹהֶל), At 7:44, Ap 15:5.†
(AS)

G3143.def:
μαρτύρομαι
(μάρτυρ), [in LXX: Jdth.7:28, 1Ma.2:56 א)* ;]
to summon as witness (M, Th., 25 f.; Hort., 1Pe., 53 f.; Lft., Notes, 29; Ga 203), hence,
__(a) to protest, affirm solemnly: before ὅτι, At 20:26, Gl 5:3;
__(b) to adjure, beseech: with dative of person(s), At 26:22; with accusative and inf., Ef 4:17; before εἰς, 1Ts 2:12 (cf. δια-, προ-μαρτύρομαι).†
(AS)

G3144.def:
μάρτυς
(Æolic μάρτυρ), -υρος, ὁ (also ἡ), [in LXX for עֵד ;]
a witness: At 10:41, 1Tm 6:12, 2Tm 2:2, Hb 12:1 (Westc., in l); in forensic sense, Mt 18:16 26:65, Mc 14:63, At 6:13 7:58, 2Co 13:1, 1Tm 5:19, Hb 10:28; with genitive obj., Lc 24:48, At 1:22 2:32 3:15 5:32 10:39 26:16, 1Pe 5:1; with genitive poss., At 1:8 13:31, Ap 11:3; with dative of person(s), Lc 11:48, At 22:15; of Christ, Ap 1:5 3:14; of God, Rm 1:9, 2Co 1:23, Fp 1:8, 1Ts 2:5 2:10; of those who have witnessed for Christ by their death (in later Xn. lit., martyr: Swete, Ap., 35), At 22:20, Ap 2:13 17:6.†
(AS)

G3145.def:
μασάομαι (Rec. μασσ), -ῶμαι
(Aristoph. and late writers, but not in Trag. or in good Att.. prose), [in LXX: Jó 30:4 (לֶחֶם), Sir.19:9 A * ;]
to bite, chew: Ap 16:10.†
(AS)

G3146.def:
μαστιγόω, -ῶ
(μάστιξ) [in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi. ;]
to scourge: with accusative, Mt 10:17 20:19 23:34, Mc 10:34, Lc 18:33, Jo 19:1; metaphorically, Hb 12:6 (cf. Pv 3:12, Jr 5:3, Jdth.8:27).†
(AS)

G3147.def:
μαστίζω
(Ep. and late prose = Att.. μαστιγόω) [in LXX: Nm 22:25 (נָכָה hi.), Wis.5:11, 2Ma.2:21 * ;]
to whip, scourge: with accusative, At 22:25.†
(AS)

G3148.def:
μάστιξ, -ιγος, ἡ
[in LXX for שׁוֹט, etc. ;]
a whip, scourge: At 22:24, Hb 11:36; metaphorically, of disease or suffering as a divine chastisement (cf. Sl 89:33, Pv 3:12, 2Ma.9:11), Mc 3:10 5:29, 34, Lc 7:21
(AS)

G3149.def:
μαστός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שַׁד ;]
the breast: pl., Lc 11:27 23:29, Ap 1:13 (T, μασθοῖς; WH, App., 149; L, μαζοῖς).†
(AS)

G3152.def:
μάταιος, -ον
(as in Att.., but -αία, -αιον, 1Co 15:17, 1Pe 1:18; μάτην), [in LXX for שָׁוְא, הֶבֶל, כָּזָב, etc. ;]
vain, useless: ἀνωφελὴς κ. μ., Tt 3:9; πίστις, 1Co 15:17; θρησκεία, Tg 1:26; διαλογισμοί, 1Co 3:20 (LXX); ἀναστροφή, 1Pe 1:18; of idols and heathen gods, τὰ μ. (Jr 2:5, 4Ki.17:15, al.): At 14:15
SYN.: κενός, q.v (AS)

G3153.def:
ματαιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(μάταιος), [in LXX for הֶבֶל, Sl 31:6 39:5 62:9, al., and nearly 40 times in Ec; for שָׁוְא, Sl 25:4, al.; רִיק, etc. ;]
vanity, emptiness, frailty, folly: Rm 8:20, 2Pe 2:18; τ. νοός, Ef 4:17 (elsewhere only in Pollux, 6, 134, and Eccl.).†
(AS)

G3154.def:
ματαιόω, -ῶ
(μάταιος), [in LXX: 4Ki.17:15, Jr 2:5, al. הָבַל, etc. ;]
to make vain, foolish: Rm 1:21.†
(AS)

G3155.def:
μάτην
(prop. accusative of μάτη, a fault, folly), adv., [in LXX for הָבַל, שָׁוְא, etc. ;]
in vain, to no purpose: Mt 15:9, Mc 7:7" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3156.def:
Μαθθαῖος (Rec. Ματθ-, see WH, App., 159; Bl., § 3, 11; on the Semitic form, see Dalman, Words, 51; Gr., 142), -ου, ὁ,
Matthew: Mt title., Mt 9:9 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:15, At 1:13 (cf. Λευεί).†
(AS)

G3157.def:
Μαθθάν (Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ indecl. (Heb. מַתָּן),
Matthan: Mt 1:15.†
(AS)

G3158G.def:
Μαθθάτ (T, -άθ; Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. מַתָּת),
Matthat: Lc 3:29 (cf. Ματθάτ).†
Matthat: Lc 3:24 (T, Μαθθάθ),†
Ματθάτ (see: Μαθθάτ),
(AS)

G3158H.def:
Μαθθάτ (T, -άθ; Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. מַתָּת),
Matthat: Lc 3:29 (cf. Ματθάτ).†
Matthat: Lc 3:24 (T, Μαθθάθ),†
Ματθάτ (see: Μαθθάτ),
(AS)

G3159.def:
Μαθθίας (Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), -α, ὁ (Heb. מַתָּת),
Matthias: At 1:23, 26.†
(AS)

G3162.def:
μάχαιρα, -ης
(Att.. -ας; see WH, App., 1568; ΒΙ., § 7, 1), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶב; also for מַאֲכֶלֶת, etc. ;]
__1. (in Hom., al.) a large knife or dirk, for sacrificial purposes (Gn 22:6, 10, Jz 19:20 A).
__2. a short sword or dagger (as disting. from ῥομφαία, a large broad sword and ξίφος, a straight sword for thrusting): Mt 26:47 ff., Mc 14:43, 47-48, Lc 22:36 ff., Jo 18:10-11 At 16:27, Hb 11:37, Ap 6:4 13:10, 14; στόμα μαχαίρης (as in Heb. חֶרֶב פֶּה, Gn 34:26, al.), the edge of the sword: Lc 21:24, Hb 11:34; μ. δίστομος, Hb 4:12; ἀναιρεῖν μαχαίρῃ, At 12:2; τὴν μ. φορεῖν, Rm 13:4. Metaphorical, Mt 10:34 (opposite to εἰρήνη), Rm 8:35; μ. τοῦ πνεῦματος, Ef 6:17.†
(AS)

G3163.def:
μάχη, -ης, ἡ
(μάχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
__1. a fight.
__2. a strife, contention, quarrel: 2Co 7:5, 2Tm 2:23, Tg 4:1; pl., Tt 3:9.†
(AS)

G3164.def:
μάχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for רִיב, also for נָצָה ni., etc. ;]
__1. to fight: At 7:26.
__2. to quarrel, dispute: 2Tm 2:24, Tg 4:2; πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Jo 6:52 (cf. δια-μάχομαι).†
(AS)

G3165.def:
1. apostrophe for με.
2. rarely for μοι, (Homer) (ML)

G3167.def:
μεγαλεῖος, -εία, -εῖον
(μέγας) [in LXX: Sl 71:19 (גָּדוֹל), al., frequently in Sir ;]
magnificent, splendid (Xen., Plut., al.) : At 2:11.†
(AS)

G3168.def:
μεγαλειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(μεγαλεῖος) [in LXX: Jr 33:9 (תִּפְאָרָה), Dan LXX 7:27, 1Es.1:5 Et 4:40 * ;]
splendour, magnificence: Lc 9:43, At 19:27, 2Pe 1:16 (frequently in π. as a ceremonial title, MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3169.def:
μεγαλοπρεπής, ές (= μεγάλῳ πρέπων),
[in LXX: Dt 33:26 (גַּאֲוָה) 2Ma.8:15 2Mac 15:13, 3Ma.2:9 * ;]
befitting a great man, magnificent, majestic: 2Pe 1:17 (cf. MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3170.def:
μεγαλύνω
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גָּדַל pi., hi. ;]
__1. to make great: Mt 23:5, Lc 1:58.
__2. to declare great, extol, magnify: Lc 1:46, At 5:13 10:46 19:17, 2Co 10:15; pass., before ἐν, Fp 1:20.†
(AS)

G3172.def:
μεγαλωσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גְּדוּלָה and cogn. forms, 2Rs 7:23, Sl 145:3, al. ;]
greatness, majesty: Hb 1:3 8:1, Ju 25 (elsewhere Eccl. only).†
(AS)

G3173.def:
μέγας, μεγάλη, μέγα,
[in LXX chiefly for גָּדוֹל, also for מַרְבֶּה ,רַב (incl. μείζων), רֹב (μέγιστος) ;]
great;
__1. of external form, bodily size, measure, extent: λίθος, Mt 2:60; δράκων, Ap 12:3; ἰχθῦς, Jo 21:11; πόλις, Ap 11:8; μάχαιρα, Ap 6:4, al.
__2. Of intensity and degree: δύναμις, At 4:33; φόβος, Mc 4:41; ἀγάπη, Jo 15:13; ἄνεμος, 'ib. 6:18; κραυγή, At 23:9; φῶς, Mt 4:16; πυρετός, Lc 4:38; θλίψις, Mt 24:21.
__3. Of rank;
__(a) of persons: θεός (MM, xvi), Tt 2:13; Ἄρτεμις, At 19:27; compar. (see infr.), Mt 18:1 (cf. Dalman, Words, 113f.); neut. for masc. (Bl., §32, 1), Mt 12:6;
__(b) of things: ἁμαρτία, Jo 19:11; μυστήριον, Ef 5:32; = μεγίστη (see infr., and cf. Field, Notes, 16f.), Mt 22:36; compar. for superl. (M, Pr., 78), 1Co 13:13.
__4.
__(a) Compar., μείζων: Mt 11:11 23:17, al.; neut. pl., μείζονα, contr. μείζω, Jo 1:51; double compar., μειζότερος (M, Pr., 236; Bl., §11, 4), III Jo 4;
__(b) superl, μέγιστος (Deiss., BS, 365), 2Pe 1:4.
(AS)

G3174.def:
μέγεθος, -ους, τό
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for קוֹמָה ;]
greatness: Ef 1:19 (cf. MM, xvi, see word μέγας).†
(AS)

G3175.def:
μεγιστάν, -ᾶνος, ὁ
(μέγιστος) [in LXX chiefly for שַׂר, Jr 24:8, al.; רַבְרְבָן, Dan LXX TH Dn 5:23, al.; frequently in Sir (sing., Sir.4:7) ;]
usually pl., οἱ μ., the chief men, nobles (Manetho, FlJ, al.): Mc 6:21, Ap 6:15 18:23.†
(AS)

G3177.def:
μεθερμηνεύω
[in LXX: Sirach prologue 23 * ;]
to translate, interpret: Mt 1:23, Mc 5:41 15:22, 34, Jo 1:38, 42, At 4:36 13:8 (cf. ἑρμηνεύω).†
(AS)

G3178.def:
μέθη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר and cognate forms ;]
drunkenness: Lc 21:34; pl., Rm 13:13, Gl 5:21 †
SYN.: see: κῶμος (AS)

G3179.def:
μεθ-ίστημι and (late form, 1Co 13:2) μεθιστάνω,
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;]
trans. in Pres., impf., fut. and aor. 1,
to change, remove: with accusative of thing(s), ὄρη, 1Co 13:2 (cf. Is 54:10); with accusative of person(s): before εἰς, Cl 1:13; before ἐκ, pass., Lc 16:4; of causing death (cf. similar intrans. sense, Eur., Alc., 21, al.), At 13:22. Metaphorical (cf. τ. καρδίαν μ., Js 14:8), with accusative of person(s), to pervert: At 19:26.†
(AS)

G3180.def:
μεθ-οδία (Rec. -εία; cf. 131., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(† μεθοδεύω, 1. to treat by rule. 2. to employ craft: 4Ki.19:27 *)
craft, deceit: Ef 4:14 6:11 (not found elsewhere; see AR, in l).†
(AS)

G3182.def:
μεθύσκω
[in LXX: Sl 23:5 (רָוָה), Pv 4:17 (שָׁתָה), etc. ;]
causal of μεθύω,
to make drunk, intoxicate; pass., to get drunk: Lc 12:45, Ef 5:18, 1Ts 5:7.†
(AS)

G3183.def:
μέθυσος, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον; prop., only of women, but in late writers also = μεθυστικός, of men), [in LXX: Pv 23:21 (סָבָא) Pv 26:9 (שִׁכּוֹר), Sir.19:1 26:8, 4Ma.2:7 * ;]
drunken: 1Co 5:11 6:10.†
(AS)

G3184.def:
μεθύω
(μέθυ, wine, cf. μέθη), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר, רָוָה ;]
to be drunken: Mt 24:49, Jo 2:10, At 2:15, 1Co 11:21, 1Ts 5:7; metaphorically, Ap 17:2, 6.†
(AS)

G3188.def:
μέλαν, τό, see: μέλας.
μέλας, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: Ct 1:5, Zc 6:2 (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;]
black: Ap 6:5, 12; opposite to λευκός, Mt 5:36; neut., τὸ μ., ink : 2Co 3:3, II Jn 12, 3Jn.13.†
(AS)

G3189.def:
μέλας, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: Ct 1:5, Zc 6:2 (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;]
black: Ap 6:5, 12; opposite to λευκός, Mt 5:36; neut., τὸ μ., ink : 2Co 3:3, II Jn 12, 3Jn.13.†
(AS)

G3191.def:
μελετάω, -ῶ
(μελέτη, care), [in LXX chiefly for הָגָה m ;]
__1. with genitive, to care for (Hes.).
__2. C. accusative to attend to, practise: 1Tm 4:15 (RV, be diligent in; cf. Souter in Exp., VIII, vi, 429, but see infr.).
__3. to study, ponder: At 4:25 (LXX) 1Tm 4:15 (AV, meditate on; cf. CGT, in l, but see supr.; cf. προ-μελετάω).†
(AS)

G3192.def:
μέλι, -τος, τό
[in LXX frequently (Gn 43:11, al.) for דְּבַשׁ; for נֹפֶת, Pv 5:3 ;]
honey: Ap 10:9-10; ἄγριον (which see), Mt 3:4, Mc 1:9.†
(AS)

G3193.def:
μελίσσιος, -α, -ον
(elsewhere † -αῖος, -ειος; μέλισσα, a bee, cf. μέλι),
made by bees: Lc 24:42 (Rec., WH, R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3194.def:
Μελίτη (Rec., R, txt.), Μελιτήνη (WH, R, mg., see WH, App., 160),
Melita, Melitene (mod. Malta) : At 28:1.†
(AS)

G3195.def:
μέλλω,
[in LXX: Jó 3:8 (עָתִיד) 19:25 (אַחֲרוֹן); elsewhere for fut., and frequently in Wi, II, 4Mac ;]
to be about to be or do;
__1. with inf. (Bl., §62, 4; 68, 2; M, Pr., 114);
__(a) of intending or being about to do of one's own free will: with inf. praes., Mt 2:13, Lc 10:1, At 3:3 5:35, Hb 8:5, 2Pe 1:12 (Field, Notes, 240), al.; with inf. aor. (Bl., §58, 3), At 12:6, Ap 3:16;
__(b) of compulsion, necessity or certainty: with inf. praes., Mt 16:27, Lc 9:31, Jo 6:71, Rm 4:24, al.; with inf. aor., Rm 8:18, Gl 3:23, Ap 3:2 12:4.
__2. Ptcp., ὁ μέλλων: absol., Rm 8:38, 1Co 3:22; τὰ μ., Cl 2:17; εἰς τὸ μ. (Field, Notes, 65); with subst., Mt 3:7 12:32 (ὁ αἰὼν ὁ μ.; LXX for עַד), At 24:25, 1Tm 4:8, Hb 2:5, al.
(AS)

G3196.def:
μέλος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for נֵתַח ;]
a member, limb of the body: 1Co 12:14 12:19 12:26 Ef 4:16 (WH, mg.), Tg 3:5; pl. (as always in cl.), τὰ μ. : Mt 5:29-30, Rm 6:13, 19 7:5, 23 12:4, 1Co 12:12 ff, Cl 3:5, Tg 3:6 4:1. Metaphorical, πόρνης, 1Co 6:15; of Christians, μ. ἀλλήλων, Rm 12:5, Ef 4:25; Χριστοῦ, 1Co 6:15; σώματος Χριστοῦ, 1Co 12:27, Ef 5:30.†
(AS)

G3199.def:
μέλω
[in LXX: Jó 22:3 (חֵפֶץ), Tob.10:5, Wis.12:13, 1Ma.14:42-43 * ;]
__1. intrans., to be an object of care, be a care; commonly in third of person(s): with dative of person(s), At 18:17; very frequently impers., 1Co 7:21; before ὅτι, Mc 4:38, Lc 10:40; with genitive of thing(s) (as frequently in Att..), 1Co 9:9; before περί, Mt 22:16, Mc 12:14, Jo 10:13 12:6, 1Pe 5:7.
__2. Trans., in act. and mid., to care for (not in LXX or NT).†
(AS)
